summary: st-test keeps building checks inside a memory-capped gate-slot scope instead of moving them into builds.slice

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

rules.detail: A gate-slot gate, heavy or eval scope directly in app-capped.slice or its app-capped-heavy.slice child counts as a build cap when the kernel reports a finite memory.max at the scope or within that approved slice chain. CPU quotas are not required for gate-slot; existing build and seat-lane caps still require both memory and CPU limits. Limits above app-capped.slice do not count.

compatibility.detail: No API, CLI or wire changes. Checks kept in place receive BUILDS_SLICE_ACTIVE=1 so the cargo front door preserves the cap too. Environment markers alone never authorize running in place.

downtime.detail: Takes effect on the next st-test run.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous builds.slice relocation for gate-slot callers.
